headline: Your Enroly waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing UK universities into the right Enroly offer-to-arrival motion. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Richard Jackson.
productSummary: Enroly automates the offer-to-arrival journey for universities, international students, and education agents. CAS Shield, compliance prep, document checking, agent portals, and student self-service cut staff admin time and keep applicants moving. Homepage: powers enrolment for over 50% of the UK higher education market. Published outcomes: cut staff admin time by 80%; Kingston University 80% open rate on CAS automation emails; University of Aberdeen 81% faster CAS assessments.
coreInsight: Richard already sells automation for CAS, visa, and arrival. The TAM is UK universities with international intake. The one routing signal is the job-keyword class in their open reqs, because Sales Nav returns that keyword in the same pull and it tells you whether they are staffing CAS/compliance, international admissions conversion, agent networks, or none of those yet. Admissions and compliance titles are the people layer after the university is routed. They are not a second TAM.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is the keyword already in the job post
sections.takeaway: LinkedIn already names the university and already prints CAS, compliance, international admissions, or agent management in the open req. That keyword is stronger than a headcount guess, and it is free to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every UK university
sections.takeaway: First match wins. CAS/visa/compliance keywords go first, then international admissions/conversion keywords, then agent-network keywords, then every remaining in-TAM university.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each job keyword gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: CAS/compliance hiring gets a sponsor-licence risk brief. Admissions hiring gets an offer-to-arrival progression map. Agent hiring gets an agent-visibility pack. The rest get the 80% admin-cut playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Protect the licence, move the funnel, see the agents, cut the admin
sections.takeaway: The list is always UK HE institutions with international intake. Titles are merge tags after routing. A/Bs sit on the exclusive routes.

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the req they already posted
sections.takeaway: Notice the keyword, poke the spreadsheet or inbox gap that keyword implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the CAS/compliance keyword first
sections.takeaway: Start where they are already staffing the sponsor-licence risk Enroly is built for. Prove reply density, then roll admissions, agents, and the admin-cut catch-all.

signalReasons: LinkedIn Sales Nav job search is the TAM: UK universities with a visible international admissions or compliance team, and the Enroly keyword in one pull.

The same pull returns CAS / visa / sponsor licence / compliance, international admissions / conversion / offer holders, or agent / partnership keywords, which is enough to route without a second enrichment product.
The ladder maps to live Enroly copy: CAS Shield and compliance prep, offer-to-arrival progression, agent portals, and the 80% admin-time cut.
Titles and intake season are merge tags. They are not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last, never the TAM spine.

sources.name: LinkedIn Sales Navigator job search
sources.delivers: UK universities plus the open-req keyword used to assign Tier 1 / 2 / 3 / catch-all. The TAM gate and the spine of every route. One pull.

sources.name: Company careers / jobs page scrape
sources.delivers: Posted role text when Sales Nav truncates the keyword, plus intake season as a merge tag when the req names September or January

sources.name: LinkedIn company + title graph
sources.delivers: Director of Admissions, Head of International, CAS Manager, Compliance Manager, Registrar after the domain is routed. Title is a merge tag, not a second TAM.

sources.name: HESA / UK university directory
sources.delivers: Backup TAM of UK HE providers when Sales Nav coverage is thin. Firmographics only. Do not invent international-enrolment counts.

sources.name: Apollo (after qualification)
sources.delivers: Work emails for already-routed accounts. Do not buy a raw UK university list and hope.

sources.name: Optional Enroly customer suppress
sources.delivers: Current-customer exclusion when the signal is visible. Named logos on enroly.com are not a franchise-wide exclude.

routingRules.if: job_keyword_class = cas_compliance (CAS, visa, sponsor licence, immigration compliance, BCA)
routingRules.why: They are already staffing the compliance gap CAS Shield is built for.

routingRules.if: job_keyword_class = intl_admissions (international admissions, conversion, offer holders, enrolment ops)
routingRules.why: They are hiring to move applicants, not just to file documents.

routingRules.if: job_keyword_class = agent_network (education agent, agent partnerships, agent compliance)
routingRules.why: They need one portal and one view across agents.

routingRules.if: in_tam and none of the above
routingRules.why: Still UK HE with international intake; lead with the published admin-time cut.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: CAS / compliance
tiers.trigger: Open req mentions CAS, visa, sponsor licence, immigration compliance, or BCA
tiers.pain: Manual CAS packs and document chasing put the sponsor licence at risk every intake.
tiers.valueProp: Automated compliance prep and document checking so teams recruit with confidence.
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they are already hiring against the risk

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: International admissions
tiers.trigger: Open req mentions international admissions, conversion, offer holders, or enrolment operations
tiers.pain: Offer holders stall between acceptance and arrival because tasks live in inboxes and spreadsheets.
tiers.valueProp: Timely tasks and student self-service from application to arrival.

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Agent network
tiers.trigger: Open req mentions education agents, agent partnerships, or agent compliance
tiers.pain: Agent performance and document quality are invisible until a visa fails.
tiers.valueProp: Agent portal, messaging, and shared visibility across stakeholders.

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Admin cut
tiers.trigger: In-TAM UK university with international intake, no exclusive keyword match
tiers.pain: Repetitive admin still eats the team before peak intake.
tiers.valueProp: Smart workflows that cut staff admin time by 80%.

campaigns.name: Sponsor licence risk (CAS keyword)
campaigns.strategy: Name the posted CAS/compliance role, then show the audit-ready workflow gap.
campaigns.overview: Lead with sponsor-licence risk and the Kingston / Aberdeen style outcomes only as published on enroly.com.

campaigns.name: Offer-to-arrival progression
campaigns.strategy: Name the admissions hire, poke stalled offer holders, ask for a 20-min walkthrough.
campaigns.overview: Progression and student self-service, not a compliance scare.

campaigns.name: Agent visibility
campaigns.strategy: Name the agent role, poke blind spots across markets, offer the portal overview.

campaigns.name: Admin time cut
campaigns.strategy: Lead with the published 80% admin-time cut and ask who owns offer-to-arrival.
campaigns.overview: Catch-all so every university still gets a route.

launchPlan: Pull UK university TAM from Sales Nav + HESA backup; suppress known Enroly customers when visible.
Classify open reqs into cas_compliance / intl_admissions / agent_network / none.
Launch Tier 1 (CAS/compliance) first; measure reply density for 1,500+ sends before scaling.
Add Tier 2 and Tier 3 once Tier 1 clears the scale bar; keep catch-all live for residual TAM.
Titles and intake are merge tags only; do not split a second waterfall by job title.
